warnings: Grid columns 1', 1'' and 2 sit visually close together (1.50m/3.35m/5.00m within a 5.00m bay) and two rows (C, B) place a footing at 1'' while rows E and D place one at 1' instead — verified pixel-by-pixel against the vertical grid-line witness marks (cropped/zoomed) rather than by eye, since an initial pass mis-assigned row C's pair to the wrong columns. Final reading: rows E/D use column 1' (1.50m); rows C/B use column 1'' (3.35m); no row uses both.

Footing marks F3, F4, F5, F6 each appear under BOTH a C1 (main structural post, continues up into the steel superstructure per S-12's column schedule) and a C0 (auxiliary/porch column, stops at floor level) at different grid positions — the footing TYPE (size/pile count, per S-06..S-11) is the same regardless of which column sits on it. Per schema §4 the point-element merge does not split on a differing neighbouring column mark, so each F-mark below is one merged entry; the per-position column mark is recorded in each footing's own note when it is not uniform across all its occurrences.

F3 and its A'-row twin (grid_ref E1 / A'1) are both drawn as a beveled trapezoid footing shape (not the plain square used elsewhere) — matches F3's own expanded detail on S-06 (หน้า31), which is also drawn trapezoidal. Likely a chamfered corner to clear the accessible-ramp edge (S-15) or a site boundary; the plan sheet itself gives no further explanation.

Row A' (the dummy row 1.50m below main grid A) carries 4 footings (F3, F4, F2 x2) supporting the accessible-ramp landing area (ทางลาด, see S-15/หน้า40) — no RC beam (B-mark) was found spanning between them on S-03/S-04, only the footings/pedestals themselves; this is expected for a ramp-edge foundation and does not disqualify the A' grid line (footings are point elements, independent of the beam-endpoint dummy-grid trigger).

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'footing_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 10 footing-family elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
